translation: And I will purge from among you the rebels and the ones transgressing against me — from the land of their sojournings I will bring ⟨את⟩ them out, and to the soil of Israel they shall not come, and you shall know that I ⟨am⟩ YHWH.

tokens.gloss: corrected gloss: he/it shall come (HVqi3ms; singular verb — both v1 'they shall come' and v2 'shall they come' contradict the parse)
